title: Differential changes of trichloroethylene degradation efficiency and carbon isotope fractionation during oxygenation of different Fe(II) species
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,28137-28144
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA08439J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Rong Chen, Jiayu Liu, Hao Yu
Hydroxyl radicals (˙OH) generated from Fe(II) oxidation by O2 play a key role in chlorinated hydrocarbon (CHC) degradation, yet the effects of different Fe(II) species on degradation kinetics and carbon isotope fractionation remain unclear.
